strings.title: Stream Interrupted
strings.hint: Who knew what she would reveal in the twentieth minute of the stream? Trace who deliberately switched off the circuit breaker.
strings.solvedText:
The culprit: Haitham Qaddour — her manager.

Leen discovered that he had been stealing half her advertising revenue through a shell company. She decided to terminate his contract and expose him live to her million followers. At a calculated moment, he cut the power from the building's electrical panel, entered with his spare key, sedated her and took her through the service entrance to a production apartment rented under that same shell company's name.

Leen was found sedated but unharmed within 48 hours. The evidence against him: his fingerprint on the circuit breaker, the 'Production' van on the neighbors' camera, and the fact that the only message he deleted from her phone was the stream schedule — including the segment 'The whole truth about my manager.'
strings.summary.text: During a livestream watched by thousands, the power in influencer Leen Al-Sayegh's apartment went out for exactly 40 seconds. When the camera came back, her chair was empty and her headset was still swinging. No scream, no sign of forced entry, and the apartment door was shut. Her last words before the darkness: 'After the break… I'll tell you a truth you've never heard before.'

strings.summary.victim.name: Leen Al-Sayegh
strings.summary.victim.note: Missing — later found alive (see confidential files)
strings.summary.timeline[2].l: Stream returns to an empty chair
strings.scene.address: Leen's apartment — fifth floor; basement electrical room
strings.scene.intro: The streaming room is undisturbed: no struggle or disorder, but her juice contains traces of a fast-acting sedative. Only her apartment's breaker was manually switched off in the basement panel. The rear service door was opened with a key, not forced.
strings.scene.photos[0].cap: Man in a cap crosses the service entrance at 21:17
strings.scene.notes[0]: Breaker switched off manually — no building-wide fault
strings.scene.notes[1]: Fast-acting sedative traces in the juice
strings.scene.notes[2]: Service door opened with a spare key
strings.scene.notes[3]: One message deleted from her phone an hour before the stream
strings.evidence[0].title: Circuit breaker
strings.evidence[0].desc: A fresh partial fingerprint on the breaker serving only Leen's apartment.
strings.evidence[1].title: Neighbors' camera still
strings.evidence[1].desc: A van marked 'Production' waits at the service entrance for 6 minutes during the outage.
strings.evidence[2].title: Stream schedule
strings.evidence[2].desc: The deleted final segment: 'The whole truth about my manager — in numbers.'
strings.evidence[3].title: Glass of juice
strings.evidence[3].desc: A fast-acting sedative. The drink was prepared before the stream by someone who entered the apartment during the day.
strings.evidence[4].title: Advertising contract
strings.evidence[4].desc: Payments were consistently short, with transfers to an unknown intermediary company over the past 14 months.
strings.evidence[5].title: Obsessive fan's messages
strings.evidence[5].desc: Repeated emotional threats — a longstanding source of harassment and an initial line of inquiry.
strings.suspects[0].name: Haitham Qaddour
strings.suspects[0].alibi: 'I was watching her stream from my office and was as shocked as everyone else. I called her 14 times.'
strings.suspects[0].statement: Leen is my greatest success. I wouldn't destroy what I've built. Our recent financial dispute was an accounting misunderstanding that we were going to resolve. You should be chasing the obsessive fan who's been messaging her for a year — I gave you his messages myself.
strings.suspects[1].name: Saif Al-Najjar
strings.suspects[1].alibi: 'I was watching and commenting live — my account proves it.'
strings.suspects[1].statement: I love her from a distance. I've never gone near her building. My comments were posted at the exact time of the outage. Who kidnaps someone while publicly typing 'come back' to her?
strings.suspects[2].name: Rana, childhood friend
strings.suspects[2].alibi: 'I was at a photo shoot outside the city — the client can confirm it.'
strings.suspects[2].statement: I stopped working with her two months ago after a pay dispute, but she's still like a sister to me. I called the police within half an hour. I returned my spare key in front of the doorman on the day I left — put that on record.
strings.witnesses[0].name: Building doorman
strings.witnesses[0].statement: Two hours before the stream, a smartly dressed man went downstairs. He said he was a meter technician and showed a company permit. His company had the same name as the advertising company receiving Leen's money.
strings.witnesses[1].name: Fifth-floor neighbor
strings.witnesses[1].statement: During the darkness, I heard wheels carrying something heavy toward the service door — a wheelchair or an equipment trolley.
strings.witnesses[2].name: Livestream viewers
strings.witnesses[2].statement: The final frame before the outage shows a man's silhouette in the room's mirror. He is wearing a large watch on his right wrist.
strings.folders[0].name: Incident reports
strings.folders[0].docs[0].title: Missing person report
strings.folders[0].docs[0].body: Rana reported her friend missing after calls went unanswered and the stream returned to an empty chair.
strings.folders[1].name: Forensic evidence
strings.folders[1].docs[0].title: Circuit breaker report
strings.folders[1].docs[0].body: The partial print on the apartment's breaker has a preliminary reported match of 82% to the manager.
strings.folders[1].docs[1].title: Juice glass report
strings.folders[1].docs[1].body: Fast-acting sedative in the juice, prepared hours before the stream. The culprit entered the apartment during the day using a key.
strings.folders[2].name: Interviews
strings.folders[2].docs[0].title: Manager's interview
strings.folders[2].docs[0].body: He denied entering the basement. The doorman identified him as the 'meter technician.' His large watch matches the silhouette in the mirror.
strings.folders[2].docs[1].title: Fan's interview
strings.folders[2].docs[1].body: His live comment history covers the entire outage, originating from the network address of his distant home.
strings.folders[2].docs[2].title: Rana's interview
strings.folders[2].docs[2].body: The client and timestamped photographs confirm the photo shoot outside the city.
strings.folders[3].name: Records
strings.folders[3].docs[0].title: Intermediary company records
strings.folders[3].docs[0].body: The advertising intermediary is registered to a relative of Haitham and ultimately transfers its profits to his account.
strings.folders[3].docs[1].title: Van rental record
strings.folders[3].docs[1].body: The 'Production' van was rented using Haitham's company card 3 days earlier, along with a furnished apartment in the industrial district.
strings.folders[4].name: Confidential files
strings.folders[4].docs[0].title: Leen's rescue report
strings.folders[4].docs[0].body: A raid on the rented apartment found Leen sedated but unharmed. The hired guard had instructions in Haitham's handwriting.
strings.folders[4].docs[1].title: Transcript of the canceled segment
strings.folders[4].docs[1].body: An audio draft on her phone: 'My manager stole half of what I earned… and I'm going to show you the transfers now.'
strings.reports[0].title: The forty-second window
strings.reports[0].author: Investigation team
strings.reports[0].body: The operation was timed to the second: manual power cut, entry with a key, prior sedation, removal through the service entrance. Only someone intimately familiar with her stream's rhythm could manage that timing.
strings.reports[1].title: Financial trail report
strings.reports[1].author: Financial investigation unit
strings.reports[1].body: Systematic embezzlement through the intermediary company exceeds 800 thousand. Public exposure would have ruined the manager legally and professionally.
strings.notes[0].text: Exactly 40 seconds — deliberate timing by someone who knows the stream
strings.notes[1].text: The silhouette in the mirror wears a large watch. Who wears one like that?
